What is the order of magnitude of the number of atoms in the body of a 70 kg person? (Assume the body is mostly water.)
questions.e: In water there are on average $18/3=6$ g/mol per atom: $70\,000/6\approx10^4$ mol, and $10^4\cdot6\cdot10^{23}\approx10^{27}$.
